correctness.rationale: Direct Laplacian proof reduces the claim to one and two firings per vertex in three steps. Exact local threshold inequalities classify all hub phases and leaf choices. The chip complement is a bijection, and the binomial size-bias argument proves the mass limit. Independently coded direct-update and firing-phase verifiers passed for \(1\le n\le6\) and \(1\le n\le8\) respectively; these support but do not replace the infinite proof. The removal graph conclusion invokes Jiang 2010 Theorem 3.10 with precisely matching \(K_{2,n}\) hypotheses.

value.rationale: The one-edge transition from \(K_{2,n}\), whose dynamics exclude primitive-three, to \(K_{n,1,1}\), which has \(6n\,2^n\) primitive-three states, is a motivated graph-perturbation question. Exact mass coefficients, sharp forbidden band, and asymptotically separated conditional uniform laws are non-implied structural information for an infinite labelled family, beyond merely constructing one period-three orbit.
